practiceReport.beatComment: Hicks was not listed on Monday's injury report, but he was unable to practice Tuesday due to a concussion. He's mostly played on special teams this season, but his absence thins the Bears' depth at safety behind starters Cam Lewis and rookie first-rounder Dillon Thieneman. Hicks' next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Jaguars on Sunday, Dec. 6.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Dayo Odeyingbo
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 10 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Odeyingbo had already been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, and he'll now be required to miss at least the next four contests. The 27-year-old is second on the team with 3.0 sacks this season. His placement on injured reserve coupled with Montez Sweat's PED suspension is a big hit to the Bears' pass rush.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Hayden Large
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Courtney Cronin of ESPN.com reports general manager Ryan Poles stated the Bears will "remain flexible" on both Large and safety Coby Bryant (knee) as they manage their injuries. Large must spend at least four regular-season games on IR before becoming eligible to return to the team's 53-man roster. The status of the tight end's injury still remains unclear, so it is uncertain if he will need longer to recover.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Tony Fields II
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Fields is set to be the primary backup edge rusher for the Bears in 2026. The linebacker signed with the Bears in June after being out of the league in 2025. As a result of Sunday's transaction, Fields will now need to wait at least another four regular-season games to see any game action.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Zavier Scott
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 10 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Scott will be required to miss at least the next four games. He's appeared in four contests this season, playing 65 snaps on special teams.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Coby Bryant
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Week 10 Bye excluded from NFL 4-game minimum count
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Johnson said that Bryant's timeline for return is still indefinite, but it looks like a possibility he could be back on the field as soon as December or January. He is recovering from a knee surgery he underwent back in August after he suffered a hyperextension during training camp. Per Cronin, he is still on a four- to six-month timeline to return.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Braxton Jones
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Jones underwent right knee surgery Tuesday, and as a result, he will be forced to miss the remainder of the 2026 campaign. In his absence, Theo Benedet (shoulder) will continue to operate as the team's primary option at left tackle.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Brittain Brown
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Brown signed a reserve/future contract with Chicago in January, and he turned 14 carries into 22 yards while also catching four of five targets for 22 yards and a score during the preseason. The running back is dealing with an undisclosed injury, and he is now set to miss the entire season while on IR, unless he can reach an injury settlement with the team.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Cole Kmet
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Kmet suffered a season-ending right knee injury during the fourth quarter of the Bears' 30-24 win over the Patriots on Thursday. Even with the emergence of Colston Loveland, Kmet was still a key piece in Chicago's offense as a run blocker, and he'll end his 2026 regular season with a 10-87-1 receiving line (on 14 targets) across seven games. Rookie third-rounder Sam Roush is the only other healthy tight end on the 53-man roster other than Loveland, so the Bears could look to bolster the position group by trade or free agency.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Dallis Flowers
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Kentavius Street
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Street was injured in Monday night's win over the Seahawks and had to be carted to the locker room. He's now expected to miss the remainder of the 2026 season. Fellow DT Grady Jarrett (groin) was also injured in Seattle, making the move for Jeffery Simmons that much more important for Chicago.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Nephi Sewell
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Sewell was fighting a losing battle to make the 53-man roster before his injury, so season-ending injury reserve for a concussion is no surprise. The linebacker will now spend the entirety of the 2026 regular season on IR unless he is waived with an injury settlement.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Nikola Kalinic
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026

irAndReserveTracker.name: Ruben Hyppolite II
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Hyppolite is dealing with a shoulder injury that he picked up during the Bears' second preseason game against the Browns on Aug. 15. He was waived/injured by Chicago on Sunday, but he was moved to IR on Monday after going unclaimed. Hyppolite will be forced to sit for the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement with the Bears.
